decision.approval_source: Explicit user direction for work item #520 in the active conversation.
decision.interpretation: Create a new accepted decision for the existing narrow repository-seed writes, align current authority references, and add scoped verification without a runtime behavior change or blanket confinement claim. Supersede only ADR-0008's blanket write-confinement clauses. Preserve its layer ownership and existing-human-narrative protections.

authority_scope.scaffold: Absent generated workflow targets can use the repository-seed writer. Existing targets are skipped under the MCP mutation permit.
authority_scope.fresh_init: The fresh-target gate rejects an existing .agent/, specs/, skills/, AGENTS.md, CONVENTIONS.md, .githooks/, or .github/ target. Per-path scaffold checks preserve other generated path collisions. The only authorized specs write is a new empty specs/adr/.gitkeep marker. Selected package-manifest files and generated workflow files are seeded under repository containment checks.
authority_scope.managed_upgrade: Only ownership-planned generated and package-manifest paths can change. Unowned collisions and local edits are preserved. Apply uses the writer lease, clean-worktree check, preimage and postimage checks, transaction journal, validation, and rollback. It does not manage specs/**.
authority_scope.excluded: No general repository mutation authority, no mutation of existing human narrative, no runtime redesign, and no blanket claim that every runtime write stays under .agent/.

release_interpretation.historical_evidence: The retained 1.0.4 scaffold observation remains immutable historical evidence and does not certify 1.0.5.

required_runtime_smoke.command: repo_root=$PWD; tmp=$(mktemp -d); (cd "$tmp" && "$repo_root/runtime/target/debug/truenorth-mcp" init --profile generic --bundle-dir "$repo_root/npm") && test -f "$tmp/AGENTS.md" && test -f "$tmp/CONVENTIONS.md" && test -f "$tmp/specs/adr/.gitkeep" && test -f "$tmp/.agent/workspace-manifest.yml" && printf 'human narrative\n' > "$tmp/specs/human.md" && (cd "$tmp" && "$repo_root/runtime/target/debug/truenorth-mcp" upgrade --check --bundle-dir "$repo_root/npm") && test "$(cat "$tmp/specs/human.md")" = "human narrative"
required_runtime_smoke.limits: Run after the parent builds the current binary and prepares matching 1.0.5 package metadata. This smoke observes fresh initialization and a read-only upgrade plan. The full parent verification must also exercise scaffold collision preservation and managed-upgrade apply and rollback behavior.

scope_limits: This record proves the approval and authority interpretation only. It does not prove runtime behavior, release compliance, integration, publication, or historical gaps.
